desc: The streamlined design of the DAKA Single Pistol Case makes it ideal for use inside larger hard cases, during vehicle transport, or storage inside gun safes. Its internal, snag-free, protective EVA foam liner adds a layer of security and a barrier against damage. Constructed of durable DAKA material and featuring a water-resistant YKK AquaGuard zipper, a 550 paracord zipper pull, and a pull-tab that doubles as a carabiner passthrough, the DAKA Single Pistol Case is rugged, water resistant, and the perfect storage solution for your pistol and more.
